about: mixamo-retarget M3 recipes (scripts/mocap/mixamoEmit.mjs): one per keyed Mixamo clip, by slug (PLAN.md 'Clip map'). kind gait | loop | timed; file = the FBX as downloaded; title = the site's title (the file without .fbx and any '(...)' note); target = the game state it is for; trim 'auto' (timed: the moving span, joint speed over the threshold, 0.1 s margin) or [s0, s1] seconds of the take; travel z | +x | -x | none; inPlace 'auto' (A4: hips travel under 5 cm) or true / false; gait = the planner band of a gait clip (walk); ownTrack keeps the capture's own track half; channels = the optional keyed channels written (head; clav / fing / fore are not emitted yet, M3-REPORT open items); studio = the Anim Studio row (mocapSources.ts MocapStudio keyed: body, move, crouch, circle; cycle is measured).

crouched_walking.title: Crouched Walking
crouched_walking.target: crouched sneak (MOCAP_CROUCH_WALK if it measures as well, A8)

crawling_prone.title: Crawling Prone
crawling_prone.limits: lies flat on the floor: the keyed format poses the pelvis, trunk, head and arms; the legs are the foot planner IK legs under that low pelvis (no leg channel from a capture), so they fold instead of lying straight, and the dragging toes read as contacts (see the slide and reach columns)

carry_body_idle.title: Carry Body Idle
carry_body_idle.target: standing with a carried body (J19 hand-off)

crouch_to_stand.title: Crouch To Stand
crouch_to_stand.target: stand-up from a crouch (I3, min 0.3 s)
crouch_to_stand.limits: starts crouched with the take's own depth (lowest pelvis column), not the game crouch height

stand_to_crouch.title: Stand To Crouch
stand_to_crouch.limits: ends crouched with the take's own depth (lowest pelvis column), not the game crouch height

kneel_down.title: Kneel Down
kneel_down.target: laying a body down (J19 R11 hand-off)
kneel_down.limits: the knees on the floor are not carried (planner IK legs, no leg channel): the trunk lowers over standing feet and reads as a deep squat

kneeling_pull_up.title: Kneeling Pull Up
kneeling_pull_up.target: team pull, the hauler (Campaign / Marlow hand-off)
kneeling_pull_up.limits: kneels throughout: the knees on the floor are not carried (planner IK legs), so the hauling trunk and arms play over a deep squat

pulling_up_to_a_ledge.title: Pulling Up To A Ledge
pulling_up_to_a_ledge.target: team pull, the climber's side (Campaign / Marlow hand-off)
pulling_up_to_a_ledge.limits: climbs about 1.75 m up onto a ledge: the clip has no ledge or game root path (the hips rise in pel), so on flat Studio ground Wren rises into the air; the game wiring (hand-off) must move the root as attachController does for the climb-up

lifting_heavy_object.title: Lifting Heavy Object
lifting_heavy_object.target: shutter lift and hold (Campaign / Marlow hand-off)
lifting_heavy_object.limits: a long squat-lift-hold take kept whole (its moving span is almost all of it); the hands follow the take, no object anchors
